decisions.reason: The power button's appearance changes, but its established front-panel placement remains unchanged.
The visual treatment of the power button does not alter electrical load capacity, supply sizing, or overload protection.
The power button appearance does not change the prototype's standard 120V wall-power source.
This candidate already has an independent same-message MODIFY for the silver DJ-style buttons and knobs; the master power button appearance remains owned by the source Requirement.
Bowl lighting is an independent clause already represented by a same-message Event and is not changed by the power button appearance decision.
Liking the rendered power button appearance does not necessarily change any selected component or BOM deliverable.
The discussion of AI-rendered proportions and power button appearance does not modify the spout's geometry, material, orientation, or rendering-based appearance requirement.
The power button's visual appearance has no necessary effect on splash mitigation or operating cleanliness.
The statement about exploring a K does not rescind or concretely modify the existing cursive-K markings on each dispense button.
The power button appearance does not alter the placard wording, position, or viewing orientations.
Measurement units around the bowls are an independent same-message requirement and do not change as a consequence of the power button appearance decision.
The power button's rendered appearance does not affect mixing quality, foam performance, whisk selection, or whisk positioning.
